name: rpi-web
description: rpi web client — vite + react + typescript, built into the rpi binary via build.rs

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rm -rf .web-test-build && esbuild scripts/transcript.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/transcript.test.mjs && esbuild scripts/realtime.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/realtime.test.mjs && esbuild scripts/goal.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/goal.test.mjs && esbuild scripts/socket.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/socket.test.mjs && esbuild scripts/hostToken.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/hostToken.test.mjs && esbuild scripts/sessionPreference.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.web-test-build/sessionPreference.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/transcript.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/realtime.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/goal.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/socket.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/hostToken.test.mjs && node .web-test-build/sessionPreference.test.mjs && rm -rf .web-test-build && vite build && node scripts/trim-dist.mjs
